# FramedList

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:framed-list` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

An inset-grouped list: one rounded, bordered frame with dividers between rows of arbitrary content.

## When to use

Group settings-style rows of arbitrary content (copy, keycaps, controls) in one framed surface with between-row dividers and an optional highlighted row, without app list CSS.

- Settings rows, account or source cards, or shortcut lists group several rows of arbitrary content in one framed surface.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for read-only label/value facts; use ValueTable.
- Do not use for selectable navigation rows; use List with ListItem.
- Do not pad or border its rows from application CSS; FramedListRow owns the inset and divider.

**Alternatives:**

- [ValueTable](./value-table.md) (nearest) — Use ValueTable when every row is a label and a value.
- [List](./list.md) (nearest) — Use List with ListItem for navigation or selectable rows.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/framed-list` — exports `FramedList`, `FramedListRow`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/framed-list` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/framed-list.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/framed-list`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuiframed-list) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- lowered surface
- base surface
- highlighted row

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** row content and its controls; which row is highlighted; the list's accessible name.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: self · border: self · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Rows own the 8px inset and the inset 1px divider above them; the frame owns the 8px margin, border, and radius.

## Accessibility

- Renders a list (ul role=list, li rows); pass label when no heading names it. Highlight is visual; carry its meaning in row content or a control's state.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-framed-list`, `kui-framed-list__row`.

Never put `kui-framed-list`, `kui-framed-list__row` on an element you write; render `FramedList` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-framed-list-border`, `--kui-color-neutral-border-normal`, `--kui-color-surface-lowered`, `--kui-color-surface`, `--kui-color-brand-fill-quiet`, `--kui-layout-inline-margin`, `--kui-layout-item-padding`, `--kui-layout-rounded-radius`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
